components.title: AI-Native Testing Landscape Overview
components.teaches: Students will identify the unique challenges of testing AI-native systems, including nondeterminism, data drift, and model versioning. They will distinguish between model-centric and system-centric testing concerns.

components.title: Unit Testing ML Model Components
components.teaches: Students will describe unit-level testing mechanisms such as property-based testing, metamorphic testing, and test oracle construction for individual model functions. They will explain how these mechanisms detect logic errors in preprocessing, inference, and postprocessing.

components.title: Integration Testing of ML Pipelines
components.teaches: Students will outline integration testing strategies for end-to-end ML pipelines, including contract testing, schema validation, and pipeline replay. They will compare static vs dynamic pipeline validation approaches.

components.title: Model Performance Evaluation Metrics
components.teaches: Students will define key model-centric metrics such as accuracy, F1, AUC, calibration error, and perplexity, and explain when each is appropriate. They will interpret metric trade-offs for classification, generation, and ranking tasks.

components.title: System-Level Quality Metrics
components.teaches: Students will describe system-level metrics including latency, throughput, memory footprint, robustness to adversarial inputs, and data freshness. They will relate these metrics to SLA requirements in production AI services.

components.title: Mapping Mechanisms to Metrics
components.teaches: Students will apply a comparative framework that links each testing mechanism to the metrics it informs, highlighting coverage gaps. They will evaluate which combination of mechanisms yields comprehensive metric coverage for a given architecture.

components.title: Case Study: RAG Pipeline Evaluation
components.teaches: Students will walk through a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline, applying unit, integration, and system tests, and compute model and system metrics. They will critique the evaluation plan and suggest improvements.
